question: Name the Union territory with the lowest density of population as per Census of India 2011.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar Islands**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands have the **lowest population density** among Union Territories in India, according to the Census 2011.
 
• The population density of Andaman and Nicobar Islands is **46 persons per square kilometer**, which is significantly lower than other Union Territories.
 
• This Union Territory consists of **572 islands**, with only a few being inhabited, contributing to its low population density.
 
• The region has dense forest cover, with forests occupying about **86% of the total area**, leaving limited land for human habitation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population Density:** It refers to the number of people living per unit of area, typically measured as persons per square kilometer.
 
• **Census 2011:** The Census of India is conducted every 10 years, and the 2011 Census was the 15th National Census since 1872.
 
• **Union Territories of India:** These are administrative divisions governed directly by the Central Government. There are currently 8 Union Territories in India.
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar Islands:** A Union Territory of India located in the Bay of Bengal, known for its rich biodiversity and indigenous tribal communities.
 
• **Forest Cover:** The extensive forest cover in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands plays a key role in maintaining ecological balance but limits the extent of human settlement.
